name: Compare Documents
description: Compare two or more documents or versions side by side: what matches, what differs, what one leaves out, with the exact wording and where it is.
abilities: Picks the points that matter and lines the documents up in one table
Shows exact values and wording, never a paraphrase of a number
Lists what changed between versions, using Python's difflib when the text is long
Marks what a document doesn't state instead of guessing
permissions: Reads files you attach, files in your workspace and passages Knowledge Search finds
Uses the Code Sandbox plugin for exact differences between versions
